description.value: Days Inn Golden is a franchise hotel operated under the Days Inn by Wyndham brand, located in Golden, BC — a gateway community to Yoho and Glacier National Parks and a stop on several major cycling routes through the Rocky Mountains. As a full-service roadside hotel it offers standard room accommodation in a town with limited lodging options for touring cyclists. The Wyndham Rewards loyalty program is available for guests booking direct.
